rubrics.justification: The response explicitly states no image was provided and bases morphology only on the Gardner text, so it does not actually assess visible image features. It also inaccurately calls 3AA the 'highest' grade/top-tier when higher expansion stages exist.

It thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, PCOS/high response, endometrial thickness, prior live birth, ovarian reserve, BMI/lifestyle, and sperm motility with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible age-adjusted prognosis. Minor issues include overstatement of 3AA as the highest grade and some assumptions such as likely ICSI/FET.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: SET for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, OHSS awareness in PCOS, luteal support, and discussion of PGT-A. Slight deviations include somewhat strong preference for freeze-all/FET without full cycle context.

Provides clear practical steps for transfer strategy, OHSS monitoring, luteal support, future PGT-A discussion, sperm DNA fragmentation testing if needed, and cryopreservation planning. Some recommendations are conditional on assumptions not provided.
